title: Track 3 completion gate
purpose: Single auditable statement of what is closed in the public repository and what remains outside the capability of a public registry.

public_evidence_accounting.semantics: Terminal assessment, no-public-record and missing-source states are evidence-accounting states, never proof of absence.

empirical_track3_verification.reason: A public repository cannot create missing transaction-level, serial-level, inspection, recycling, covert-facility intelligence or independently governed verification evidence.
external_capability_required: Globally complete accelerator production and vendor-sales declarations
Transaction-level sale, resale and transfer records with stable identifiers
Authorized physical inspections and chain of custody
Closed sampling population and reproducible statistical audit outcomes
Independent verification authority and access/dispute procedures

current_public_data_boundaries.unresolved_target_reason: Public sources identify the project at Abu Dhabi/campus level but do not provide a defensible facility parcel coordinate in the retained evidence set; no coordinate is fabricated.

release_statement: The repository is engineering-complete as a public Track 3 research-infrastructure surface with zero untracked defined repository gaps. The current 93-site public-evidence layer is fully dispositioned across its defined site/domain matrix, with 631 derived remote-sensing observations across 92 sites and four closed pilot cases. Empirical Track 3 verification remains open because required privileged/global evidence and independent authority are outside this public repository.
